# Young team hero — built-in image generation

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original editorial team photograph for Cloudfianz's full-width website hero. Wide 16:9 landscape, high resolution.
Primary request: a YOUNG SOFTWARE TEAM of four people in their mid-to-late twenties, working naturally together on notebooks in a bright modern shared office. It should feel like a lively small technology team at work, not a pair of senior consultants or a staged meeting.
Composition: wide candid workplace scene, photographed at seated eye level from slightly across the communal table. The entire team and the laptops are concentrated in the RIGHT 55 percent of the frame. The LEFT 45 percent is bright, softly out-of-focus office negative space suitable for a large headline over a white fade added later in CSS. No rendered headline or text.
Foreground on the right: a woman around 26 with dark curly hair loosely tied up, wearing a relaxed ivory shirt, working at an open unbranded silver notebook. A man around 28 in a muted teal overshirt sits just to her right reviewing the same work, with his own graphite notebook nearby. Their posture is casual and collaborative, focused on the work and softly talking, no camera gaze or exaggerated smiles.
Behind them in the middle-right: another young woman with straight shoulder-length brown hair in a soft grey top working independently on a notebook across the shared table; a fourth colleague around 27 with short hair and a navy T-shirt sits nearby, also working. Arrange all four bodies and computers naturally with clear separation and realistic desk space. Background colleagues are a little softer in focus but recognizable as part of the team, not ghosted duplicates.
Environment: contemporary understated office, long light neutral worktable, daylight, a glass partition, a subtle blurred plant and ordinary functional workspace details. Stylish but credible, not a futuristic set or a luxury boardroom. Only a couple of simple cups and a notebook on the table, no clutter.
Lighting and palette: airy natural daylight, neutral whites, muted navy and sage/teal clothing accents appropriate to Cloudfianz, soft restrained contrast. Realistic documentary business photography with natural skin texture, ordinary faces, plausible hands and fingers, no beauty retouching. Younger casual team energy. Wide enough to show a team and its working environment, not a tight portrait of two faces.
Constraints: all laptops unbranded. Laptop backs mostly face camera; no readable code, interface, words, stickers or logos anywhere. No company identification, no watermark, no graphic overlays, no floating UI, no arrows, no charts. No posing for a team portrait, no handshakes, no arms crossed, no exaggerated pointing, no suited managers. No adults appearing over 35. Do not add the website fade inside the image; retain a natural continuous photograph, with left-side background already unobtrusive and softly defocused.
